simple.meaning: יַיִן (yayin) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “wine (as fermented); by implication, intoxication.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 141 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 14 more, beginning at Genesis 9:21. Its contexts include birth, family, family line, firstborn, kingship, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יַיִן (H3196).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.full: H3196. yayin יַ֫יִן 141 noun masculine Psa 75:9 wine (Late Hebrew id. ; Ethiopic : vitis, vinea, vinum ; Arabic ( black ) grapes , see Hom ZMG 1889, 654 ; Sabean וין vineyard , Mordt ZMG 1887, 364 Hom l.c. 659 (both after Glaser); Assyrian inu in vocabularies, but this loan-word from western Shemites, according to Hom Aufsätze 102 ; Jen ZA i, 186 f., ZMG 1890, 705 argues to the contrary) — absolute יַ֫יִן Gen 9:21 84t.; יָ֑יִן 14:18 33t.; construct יַ֫יִן Psa 60:5 ; Song 8:2 ; יֵין Deut 32:18 9 t.; suffix יֵינִי Song 5:1 , etc.; — wine: a. common drink, for refreshment Gen 14:18 (E?) 27:25 (J), Judg 19:19 ; 2Sam 16:2 ; Amos 5:11 ; 9:14 ; Hosea 14:8 ; Job 1:13 , 18 ; Dan 1:5 +, tonic Prov 31:6 ; article of commerce Ezek 27:18 ; Neh 13:15 ; among supplies in strongholds 2Chr 11:11 ; as making merry 2Sam 13:28 ; Zech 9:15 ; 10:7 ; Est 1:10 ; Eccl 9:7 ; 10:19 ; Psa 104:15 . b. used for rejoicing before ׳י Deut 14:26 , compare Hosea 9:4 ; as drink-offering in prescribed ritual Exod 29:40 ; Lev 23:13 ; Num 15:5 , 7 , 10 ; 28:14 ; among temple stores 1Chr 9:29 ; used also in heathen ceremonial, see Deut 32:33 . c. intoxicating 1Sam 1:14 ; 25:37 ; Gen 9:21 , 24 ; 19:32-33 , 34 , 35 (all J), Isa 5:11 , 22 ; Prov 21:17 ; 23:30-31 , +; || תִּירוֺשׁ Hosea 4:11 ; || שֵׁכָר 1Sam 1:15 ; Micah 2:11 ; Isa 24:9 ; 28:7 (twice in verse); 56:12 12 t.; forbidden to Nazirites Num 6:3 (twice in verse) ( שֵׁכָר וְחֹמֶץ יַיִן חֹמֶץ ), 6:4 ; 6:20 , compare Amos 2:12 ; to Rechabites Jer 35:2 , 5 f.; to mother of Samson Judg 13:4 , 7 , 14 ; to priests entering sanctuary Lev 10:9 (P), Ezek 44:21 ; unfitting for kings Prov 31:4 . d. combinations are : הַטּוֺב יֵין Cant 7:10 = the best wine (read כַּיַּיִן ?) Ges § 133 . 3, R. 1; מַלְכוּת יֵין Est 1:7 royal wine ; יַּיִן אֹצרְוֺת 1Chr 27:27 stores of wine, wine-supply ; הָרֶקַח יַיִן Song 8:2 spiced wine ; הַיַּיִן מִשְׁתֵּה wine-feast Est 5:6 ; 7:2 , 7 , 8 ; יַיִן סֹבְאֵי Prov 23:20 wine-bibbers ; יין נאֹד wine-skin Josh 9:4 , 13 ; 1Sam 16:20 ; יין נֵבֶל id. 1:24 ; 10:3 ; 25:18 ; 2Sam 16:1 ; Jer 13:12 (twice in verse); הַיָּ֑יִן בֵּית Song 2:4 either wine-house , where wine is drunk, feasting-house (De and others), or place of wine = vineyard (Ew and others; compare יַיִן גֶּפֶן Num 6:4 ). e. metaphor of wisdom's drink Prov 9:2 , 5 , compare Isa 55:1 ; of ׳י s wrath Jer 25:15 ( היין כּוֺס ); of confusion sent by תַּרְעֵלָה יַיִן ׳י, wine of reeling Psa 60:5 , compare 75:9 ; of ׳י s awaking for vengeance, like a wine-shouter 78:65 ; of Babylon's fierce power Jer 51:7 ; of love Song 5:1 ; חֲמָסִים יֵין Prov 4:17 ; in simile of one bursting with words Job 32:19 ; of disheartened prophet Jer 23:9 ( עֲבָרוֺיַיִן כְּגֶבֶר ); of lover's mouth Cant 7:10 (see above); love is better than wine Cant 1:2; 4:10.
